senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; קָצָה; v. קְצַת)a part; (adv.) partially, in some cases.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 6:3">Shebu. VI, 3</cite> <he>הואיל והודה לו מ׳ ממין וכ׳</he> since he has admitted a part of what is comprised in the claim (empty ‘casks’ against the claim of ‘pitchers of oil’).
<cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 6:3">Ib.</cite> <he>הודה במִקְצַת כלים</he> if he admits that he owes a portion of the vessels claimed.—

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 3a:18">B. Mets. 3ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מודה</he> (<cite ref="B00000"><he>ב</he></cite>)<he>מ׳ הטענה ישבע</he> he who admits a portion of the claim must make oath. Y. Shebu. VII, beg. 38ᵇ <he>לפי שנהנה מ׳ ומהנה מ׳ וכ׳</he> because he is benefitted to a certain extent and benefits (the owner) to a certain extent, he must swear in some cases and pay damage in other cases. Sifra Sh’mini, Par. 9, ch. XI <he>טמאת מ׳ וטהרת מ׳</he> you make it possible to declare (the seeds) unclean in some cases and clean in others.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:8">Ab. V, 8</cite> <he>מִקְצָתָן מעשרין ומקצתן וכ׳</he> if a part of the people give tithes and a part give not, v. <cite ref="B01082"><he>בַּצּוֹרֶת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:27:1">Koh. R. to VII, 27</cite>, a. e. <he>מ׳ הנפש ככל הנפש</he> loss of a part of one’s life (pain, loss of property &c.) is considered like a sacrifice of one’s entire life; a. fr.—Ch. v. <cite ref="S01857"><he>קְצָת</he></cite>.
